title: AI-Driven IT Operations Automation
description: Built AI-driven automation workflows for Linux and SAP operations using an in-house orchestration platform. Automated access provisioning, permissions management, monitoring, and operational workflows through SSH-based execution and SAP RFC integrations, reducing manual effort while maintaining governance through approval workflows and audit logging.

title: Ticket Resolution Automation System
description: Developed a multi-agent incident response platform using LangGraph to automate cloud and infrastructure ticket triage, root-cause analysis, and OS-level remediation. Integrated MCP-based operational chatbots, LangFuse observability, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows, reducing resolution times by 40–50%.

title: Skillflo - GenAI Learning Platform
description: Architected AI-powered learning platform enabling storyboard generation, assessment creation, media enrichment, and text-to-video workflows. Implemented multi-tenant RAG pipelines using ChromaDB and LlamaIndex for semantic search across storyboards and media assets, with source-grounded AI chatbots and fact-checking capabilities.

title: Semantic Media Search Engine
description: Built an enterprise semantic search platform using ChromaDB and LlamaIndex for cross-domain retrieval of images, videos, documents, and learning assets. Supported entity recognition, synonym search, and multimodal content discovery.

title: Scout AI - Children's Companion
description: Developed a real-time AI companion for children aged 4–12 using GPT-4o and FastRTC. Implemented multi-agent conversation switching, adaptive storytelling, homework assistance, AI-generated quizzes, and age-appropriate safety guardrails.

title: Storyboard Generation Platform
description: Created an AI-assisted content authoring solution that extracts knowledge from source documents and automatically generates instructional storyboards aligned with Bloom's Taxonomy and custom learning objectives.

title: Assessment Generation Engine
description: Built an AI-powered assessment generation system capable of extracting content from source documents and creating adaptive question banks, quizzes, and evaluation material for learning platforms.

title: AI-Powered Media Library
description: Developed a MERN-based media management platform that enriches images and videos with AI-generated metadata, captions, object detection, categorization, and semantic search capabilities.

title: MCP Server Ecosystem
description: Designed and developed reusable MCP servers including SSH execution, code generation, debugging, and execution services to enable secure tool integration between LLM applications, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise systems.
